decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Phoenix receipt.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Liberty receipt.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Finally Single web receipts.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Never Call Back web receipts.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Fresh Freedom deposit.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Box supplier payment.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Glass supplier payment.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Print supplier payment.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Event supplier payment.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of January payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of February payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of March payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of April payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of May payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of July payroll.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of August payroll.
decisions.answer: No reliable August-only cash amount exists. Use the combined Jan-Aug payroll evidence only.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Meta and influencer payments.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Software payments.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Repair transfer.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Packaging machine payment.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Photo booth payment.
decisions.answer: CAPEX-PHOTO €20,000 is the Regret Photo Booth equipment purchase; capitalise it.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Loan repayments.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Interest payments.

evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Villa deposit.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Owner card spending.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Water-damaged stock.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Customer insolvency.
decisions.answer: Write off R-17 receivable €18,000 after the liquidator confirmed no distribution is expected.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Former employee claim.
decisions.answer: Recognise former employee claim provision €25,000, the external counsel best estimate at 31 August.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Purchase total.
decisions.answer: Recognise €459,000 purchases from goods-received supplier invoices; confirm €126,000 closing supplier payables.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Cash collections total.
decisions.answer: Customer cash collections total €809,000: €35,000 opening receivable plus €774,000 collections on recognised current-period revenue.

decisions.question: Resolve the source and treatment of Closing bank balance.
decisions.answer: Closing bank balance is €60,000, confirmed by the bank export and post-takeover bank confirmation.

decisions.question: Classify September customer deposits.
decisions.answer: Classify €90,000 September deposits as contract liabilities, not August revenue.
decisions.aiProposal: Record the deposits as deferred revenue because delivery occurs in September.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis reached the same conclusion from the signed delivery dates and bank receipts.
decisions.studentReasoning: Cash arrived before performance. Recognition as revenue would overstate August profit by €90,000.

decisions.question: Classify New bank borrowing.
decisions.answer: Classify €50,000 new bank advance as borrowing.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Record the €50,000 as new loan principal, not income.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis confirmed that the signed bank agreement describes a repayable loan.
decisions.studentReasoning: The legal form and repayment requirement are clear. Income classification would overstate profit by €50,000.

decisions.question: Classify Packaging machine.
decisions.answer: Capitalise the €60,000 Pack-O-Matic 9000 as PPE.
decisions.aiProposal: Capitalise the machine because it is available for use and provides a long-term operating resource.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed and treated the bank payment as investing cash flow.
decisions.studentReasoning: The machine creates a long-term resource rather than restoring ordinary output.

decisions.question: Classify Photo booth.
decisions.answer: Capitalise the €20,000 Regret Photo Booth as PPE.
decisions.aiProposal: Capitalise the photo booth and depreciate it within the period estimate.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed that the booth was available for use on 10 May.
decisions.studentReasoning: The booth is equipment that remains available to support future events.

decisions.question: Classify Machine belt and calibration.
decisions.answer: Expense €10,000 belt replacement and calibration as repair.
decisions.aiProposal: Expense the repair because it restored normal output without increasing capacity or useful life.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed with the supplier description of a restoration, not an improvement.
decisions.studentReasoning: The evidence directly states that the work did not extend life or increase capacity.

decisions.question: Classify Owner villa deposit.
decisions.answer: Classify the €70,000 villa reservation as owner distribution.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Remove the villa from operating expense and record it as distribution to the owner.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed because the villa is personally owned and no customer meeting occurred.
decisions.studentReasoning: There is no business purpose supported by evidence.

decisions.question: Classify Owner card spending.
decisions.answer: Classify €40,000 owner-card spending as owner distribution.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Record the chairman card payment as a distribution, not payroll or marketing.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis reached the same conclusion from the bank and owner-card evidence.
decisions.studentReasoning: The payment lacks evidence of a genuine business purpose.

decisions.question: Classify Physical product materials consumed.
decisions.answer: Classify €405,000 materials consumed on valid delivered sales as COGS.
decisions.aiProposal: Use the independent physical-product consumption schedule as COGS.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed, while retaining the separate €9,000 stock uncertainty.
decisions.studentReasoning: Consumption relates to fulfilled product sales rather than period-end inventory.

decisions.question: Classify Event staff payroll.
decisions.answer: Classify €80,000 event-delivery staff as direct cost of events.
decisions.aiProposal: Include event delivery payroll in COGS because employees work directly on paid events.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed with the payroll file description.
decisions.studentReasoning: The work is directly attributable to delivering the service sold to customers.

decisions.question: Classify Sales team payroll.
decisions.answer: Classify €72,000 sales and partnerships payroll as selling expense.

decisions.question: Classify Office payroll.
decisions.answer: Classify €96,000 office and finance payroll as administrative expense.

decisions.question: Classify Rent.
decisions.answer: Classify €48,000 rent as operating expense.

decisions.question: Classify Marketing.
decisions.answer: Classify €55,000 marketing as operating expense.

decisions.question: Classify Software.
decisions.answer: Classify €16,000 software subscriptions as operating expense.

decisions.question: Classify Utilities.
decisions.answer: Classify €12,000 utilities as operating expense.

decisions.question: Classify Depreciation.
decisions.answer: Recognise €24,000 period depreciation.
decisions.aiProposal: Use the independent depreciation estimate of €24,000.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed but flagged missing useful-life detail as an uncertainty.
decisions.studentReasoning: The supplied asset schedule identifies €24,000 as the independent period estimate.

decisions.question: Classify Bad receivable.
decisions.answer: Recognise €18,000 bad-debt write-off for R-17.
decisions.aiProposal: Write off R-17 because no recovery is expected after liquidation.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed based on the liquidator notice.
decisions.studentReasoning: The later notice confirms insolvency already present at the reporting date.

decisions.question: Classify Damaged stock.
decisions.answer: Recognise €22,000 write-down of damaged basement stock.
decisions.aiProposal: Reduce damaged inventory to nil recoverable value.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed that physical presence does not establish recoverability.
decisions.studentReasoning: Both warehouse and independent assessment state that the stock is unsaleable.

decisions.question: Classify Probable legal claim.
decisions.answer: Recognise €25,000 provision for former employee claim.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise the external counsel best estimate as a provision.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed that the claim was probable at 31 August.
decisions.studentReasoning: The obligation arose before reporting date and is both probable and reliably estimated.

decisions.question: Classify Insurance consumed.
decisions.answer: No insurance consumption is evidenced; record €0 and retain the evidence gap as low-confidence uncertainty.

decisions.question: Classify Unpaid interest.
decisions.answer: Recognise €2,000 unpaid interest: €12,000 expense less €10,000 cash paid.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Classify Unpaid payroll.
decisions.answer: Recognise €32,000 unpaid payroll: €15,000 opening accrual plus €248,000 expense less €231,000 paid.

decisions.question: Classify Unpaid suppliers.
decisions.answer: Recognise €126,000 unpaid suppliers, independently confirmed at 31 August.

decisions.question: Classify Delivered NorthStar contract.
decisions.answer: Recognise NorthStar revenue €180,000 on accepted delivery, 12 February.
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise revenue on the accepted NorthStar delivery.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis matched the contract, CRM and bank record despite customer-name variations.
decisions.studentReasoning: Delivery and acceptance occurred before reporting date and cash was collected.

decisions.question: Classify Delivered Freedom contract.
decisions.answer: Recognise Freedom revenue €200,000 on accepted delivery, 18 March.
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise the full invoice on accepted delivery; retain €58,000 receivable.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed with the signed acceptance and partial cash collection.
decisions.studentReasoning: Recognition follows delivery, not cash collection.

decisions.question: Classify Completed Phoenix event.
decisions.answer: Recognise Phoenix revenue €100,000 on completed event, 29 April.
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise revenue when the Phoenix event was completed.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed; customer email acceptance supports completion.
decisions.studentReasoning: The service was completed before reporting date despite partial cash collection.

decisions.question: Classify Delivered Liberty order.
decisions.answer: Recognise Liberty revenue €120,000 on delivered order, 20 June.
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise the full Liberty invoice on delivery and retain €25,000 receivable.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed with delivery evidence and customer acceptance.
decisions.studentReasoning: The delivery and acceptance predate 31 August.

decisions.question: Classify Undelivered September events.
decisions.answer: Do not recognise revenue for undelivered September events; retain €90,000 deposits as liabilities.
decisions.aiProposal: Defer both September-event deposits until performance occurs.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis independently reached the same conclusion from the September delivery dates.
decisions.studentReasoning: Neither event had been delivered by 31 August.

decisions.question: Classify Loan principal payment.
decisions.answer: Classify €19,000 loan principal payment as financing cash flow and reduction of debt.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Classify Equipment purchase.
decisions.answer: Classify €80,000 equipment purchases as investing cash flow and PPE additions.

decisions.question: Estimate Closing bad-debt allowance/write-off and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Estimate bad-debt write-off at €18,000 for R-17.
decisions.aiProposal: Use the liquidator confirmation to write off the €18,000 balance.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed that recovery is not expected.
decisions.studentReasoning: The later evidence confirms the customer condition at 31 August.

decisions.question: Estimate Damaged inventory write-off and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Estimate damaged-inventory write-off at €22,000; disclose but do not provide for €2,000 future disposal.
decisions.aiProposal: Write off the unsaleable €22,000 stock and initially provide €2,000 for disposal.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis challenged the €2,000 provision because no present obligation existed at reporting date.
decisions.studentReasoning: I accepted the challenge: write down the stock, but treat future disposal cost as uncertainty until an obligation arises.

decisions.question: Estimate Legal provision and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Estimate legal provision at €25,000.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Recognise the lawyer best estimate within the €20,000-€30,000 range.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed that probability and estimation thresholds are met.
decisions.studentReasoning: External counsel confirms the condition and best estimate at reporting date.

decisions.question: Estimate Period depreciation and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Estimate period depreciation at €24,000.
decisions.aiProposal: Use the asset schedule independent depreciation estimate.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed but highlighted missing useful-life detail.
decisions.studentReasoning: The schedule provides the only quantified independent estimate; the limitation is disclosed.

decisions.question: Estimate Closing inventory and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Estimate closing inventory at €112,000, with €9,000 gross-count difference disclosed.
decisions.aiProposal: Apply the roll-forward: €80,000 opening plus €459,000 purchases less €405,000 consumption less €22,000 write-down.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed with €112,000 and separately identified the €9,000 unresolved warehouse difference.
decisions.studentReasoning: The roll-forward uses confirmed purchases and stated valid-sale consumption, while the unexplained count difference remains visible.

decisions.question: Estimate Closing receivables and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Closing receivables are €168,000: €35,000 opening plus €960,000 revenue less €809,000 collections less €18,000 write-off.

decisions.question: Estimate Repair versus improvement amount and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Expense €10,000 repair; capitalise €80,000 equipment. Repair restores normal output and does not improve the asset.

decisions.question: Estimate Insurance expense and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Insurance expense is €0 because no insurance movement is evidenced.

decisions.question: Estimate Interest payable and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Interest payable is €2,000.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Estimate Accrued payroll and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Accrued payroll is €32,000.

decisions.question: Estimate Customer deposit liability and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Customer-deposit liability is €90,000 for undelivered September events.

decisions.question: Estimate PPE closing cost and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Closing PPE cost is €260,000: €180,000 opening cost plus €80,000 additions.

decisions.question: Estimate Accumulated depreciation and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Closing accumulated depreciation is €69,000: €45,000 opening plus €24,000 period depreciation.

decisions.question: Estimate Supplier payable and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Supplier payable is €126,000, independently confirmed.

decisions.question: Estimate Closing loan and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Closing loan principal is €131,000: €100,000 opening plus €50,000 advance less €19,000 repayment.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Estimate Physical COGS and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Physical-material COGS is €405,000, based on valid delivered sales.

decisions.question: Estimate Service direct payroll and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Service direct payroll is €80,000 event-delivery staff.

decisions.question: Estimate Owner distributions and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Owner distributions total €110,000: €70,000 villa plus €40,000 owner card. Do not add an unsupported separate founder bonus.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Estimate Net profit and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Net profit is €65,000 after all approved corrections.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Estimate Closing cash and document the basis.
decisions.answer: Closing cash is €60,000, reconciled to both bank evidence and cash flow.

decisions.question: Approve corrected accounts before valuation
decisions.answer: Approve corrected accounts before valuation or earn-out analysis.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Reject the management presentation and approve corrected accounts before valuation.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed because management overstated revenue, classified debt as income and did not reconcile cash.
decisions.studentReasoning: A valuation based on the management deck would rely on materially misstated profit and financial position.

decisions.question: Freeze owner-card access
decisions.answer: Approve immediate freeze of owner-card access pending investigation and formal approval controls.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Move September deposits to contract liabilities
decisions.answer: Approve reclassification of September deposits to contract liabilities.

decisions.question: Begin weekly 13-week cash forecast
decisions.answer: Begin a weekly 13-week cash forecast because liquidity and debt maturity are key risks.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Stop credit sales to insolvent/high-risk customers
decisions.answer: Stop new credit sales to insolvent or high-risk customers until credit controls are implemented.

decisions.question: Dispose of damaged stock
decisions.answer: Approve disposal of unsaleable damaged stock, but recognise future disposal cash cost only when an obligation arises.

decisions.question: Investigate management override and duplicate sources
decisions.answer: Investigate management override, duplicate claims and unsupported classifications.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf

decisions.question: Renegotiate supplier terms
decisions.answer: Renegotiate supplier terms because €126,000 remains payable and supplier balances are confirmed.

decisions.question: Continue core Finally Single and event operations
decisions.answer: Continue core Finally Single and event operations conditionally, subject to cash forecasting, credit control and governance fixes.

decisions.question: Use claimed management profit for earn-out
decisions.answer: Do not use the management claim of €312,000 profit for earn-out; use corrected profit €65,000 only after board approval.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf
decisions.aiProposal: Reject management profit €312,000 for earn-out and rely on corrected accounts.
decisions.independentChallenge: The independent analysis agreed after reconciling cash, deposits, debt and omitted provisions.
decisions.studentReasoning: The management figure includes September deposits and loan income and omits material corrections.

lines: Rent, marketing, software, utilities and repairs

uncertainties.title: Warehouse gross-count difference
uncertainties.treatment: Closing inventory is €112,000 from the supported roll-forward; €9,000 remains unexplained and requires item-by-item investigation.

uncertainties.title: Disposal quote
uncertainties.treatment: Do not recognise a provision at 31 August because no present obligation is evidenced. Recognise expense when an obligation arises.

uncertainties.title: Depreciation useful lives
uncertainties.treatment: Use the independent €24,000 period estimate; obtain supporting useful-life and residual-value assumptions.

uncertainties.title: Former employee claim range
uncertainties.treatment: Recognise external counsel best estimate €25,000; disclosed range is €20,000-€30,000.

uncertainties.title: Insurance evidence
uncertainties.treatment: No movement is recognised because no insurance record was supplied.

boardRecommendation.conclusion: Continue core operations conditionally, but only after corrected accounts are approved and immediate cash, credit and governance controls are implemented.
actions: Approve corrected accounts before valuation or earn-out.
Freeze owner-card access and investigate overrides.
Move September deposits to contract liabilities.
Stop unsecured credit sales to insolvent or high-risk customers.
Dispose of damaged stock when authorised.
Renegotiate supplier terms and obtain debt maturity terms.
